It did not give a restart date.

item.description:
Bluefin Perps to stop trading on December 4

Bluefin will close its perpetual futures venue on December 4 at 21:00 UTC. It asked traders to close positions before the cutoff and said withdrawals would stay open for a period afterward. Bluefin says the venue accounted for 95% of Sui’s all-time perps volume. The team will focus on spot trading and tokenization.

item.description:

item.title: BNB Chain publishes new L1 litepaper BNB Chain’s litepaper details an EVM-compat
item.description:
BNB Chain publishes new L1 litepaper

BNB Chain’s litepaper details an EVM-compatible L1 for trading, payments and private finance. SubBlocks give provisional feedback before execution and finality, while dedicated lanes reserve capacity for eligible transactions. The network uses BNB and is running as a multi-validator devnet. A public testnet is still ahead.

https://www.bnbchain.org/en/blog/introducing-bnb-chains-new-l1-litepaper

item.description:

S&P puts Nvidia’s AA rating on downgrade watch

S&P Global Ratings put Nvidia’s AA issuer and senior unsecured debt ratings on CreditWatch Negative. It cited concerns about board independence, oversight and reliance on CEO Jensen Huang. S&P said it could cut the ratings within 90 days if governance concerns persist.

item.description:
U.S. Bitcoin reserve bill reaches House calendar

H.R. 8957 was reported with amendments on November 24. If enacted, it would give Treasury 180 days to set up a Bitcoin reserve and a separate digital asset stockpile. The bill would require a 20-year minimum hold for reserve BTC.

item.description:
Nvidia agrees to $290M in proposed mining-related settlement

Bloomberg Law reports that Nvidia agreed to pay $290M to resolve a securities class action. Investors alleged the company understated how much crypto mining drove demand for its gaming GPUs. The lead plaintiffs asked a federal court in California to grant preliminary approval. The deal still requires court approval.

item.description:

Bryan Pellegrino said ATLAS and the staged rollout of Zero will start Nov 30. Zero starts with 46 fixed validators and plans to open validation and switch to delegated proof of stake on Mar 31, 2027. item.description:
Strategy adds $1B to credit securities buybacks

Strategy raised its Digital Credit Securities Repurchase Program from $3B to $4B and reported buying back about $212M of STRC preferred stock.
